Career

Since its foundation in 2002, SEC Consult has grown into one of the leading cyber and application security consultancies in the world, with offices in Austria and Germany. SEC Consult is part of Atos.

Mutual appreciation and respect are the cornerstones of our actions - both internally and externally. Team spirit is not just a buzzword with us, but is lived across all levels. Our friendly working atmosphere is characterised by a large portion of flexibility, creative freedom, fun and team activities. We support and promote individual development opportunities and offer every employee the chance to realise their full personal potential.

Get to know us better

As security consultants with a holistic approach, we are constantly working to protect our clients' information and data, to keep their security levels up to date and to anchor the topic of cybersecurity in the minds of their employees. Our clientele includes companies, authorities and organisations from various industries of the private sector as well as critical infrastructure.

With a variety of exciting projects from international clients, we invite all cybersecurity experts to bring their passion to us. In addition to a wide range of tasks in a top international environment, we also offer flexible working hours, industry-standard salary models and attractive social benefits. You can expect a challenging and rapidly developing field of work that offers great future prospects for women and men alike.

We are also happy to offer summer internships to give you a first impression of the IT security sector. 

Great Place To Work: Our locations in Austria and Germany have not only been certified, but - thanks to feedback from our employees - have even received four ‘Great Place To Work’ awards!

Training: Through continuous internal and external training and further education, we are always up to date with the latest developments in the field of cybersecurity.

Work-life-balance: With flexible working hours, home office as well as the possibility to reduce hours depending on the situation, we offer the best conditions for reconciling work, passion and private life.

Public transport: Our locations are very easy to reach by public transport and in the spirit of sustainability we offer the possibility of covering the costs of an annual pass.   

Team events: Working together, celebrating together. We like to celebrate our successes and much more together.

Office & snacks: Our modern offices welcome you with fresh fruit, snacks, soft drinks and coffee. The spacious lounge areas offer a modern kitchen, a relaxation area and, of course, a Wutzler.

Each applicant is unique and comes with a unique set of experiences and talents. We look forward to getting to know each and every one of you and particularly value applicants who...

  • Show passion and enthusiasm for our services.
  • come prepared for the job-interview. Think about 2-3 questions in advance, what you would like to know yourself. If the interview takes place remotely: Check your technology before.
  • remain authentic, open and honest - the best basic conditions for cooperation
  • ask yourself in advance: "What do I want my counterpart to know about me in any case?" and make sure at the end of the conversation that this has been addressed.
  • Time is precious. Therefore make good use of time in the interview.
  • Do not regard nervousness as a disadvantage, just address it.

The company specializes in information security management, NIS security audits, penetration testing, ISO 27001 certification support, Cyber Defence and secure software certification. SEC Consult is part of Atos.
